targets.expr: (sum(pipeline_enrichment_backlog{component="domain", namespace=~"$namespace", type="unenriched"}) + sum(pipeline_enrichment_backlog{component="domain", namespace=~"$namespace", type="stale_dns"})) / (sum(rate(pipeline_enrichment_total{component="domain", namespace=~"$namespace", type=~"dns_http|re_enrich_dns"}[30m])) > 0)

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS "Label", CASE WHEN is_admin THEN 'admin' ELSE 'user' END AS "Role", strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS "Created", COALESCE(strftime(activated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'), '-') AS "Activated", COALESCE(strftime(expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'), 'never') AS "Expires", CASE WHEN revoked THEN 'revoked' WHEN activated_at IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'active' END AS "Status" FROM api_auth.api_token ORDER BY created_at
